0x000885.en: 「This... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008B7.en: 「With the strength I've got now...@　this is where it ends...!」

0x000928.en: 「Guh!@　This is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009B0.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A2A.en: 「So this is... as far as I go...?」

0x000BDA.en: 「Gah! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C15.en: 「Like hell I'm going down here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000C69.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000CDD.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D53.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DBA.en: 「This is as far as I go... The rest is on you.」

0x000DEC.en: 「Dammit...!@ This is as far as I go!」

0x000E66.en: 「It's no good, we took too many hits... Falling back!」

0x000EB3.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EF1.en: 「Eek! The rest is in your hands!」

0x000F38.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FE3.en: 「Guh... So I become a falling star... Ejecting!」

0x00111F.en: 「Nnngh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00118C.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011D3.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001208.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0012C5.en: 「Ngh... You're good, I'll give you that.」

0x0012F4.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x001342.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013FD.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00142C.en: 「Oh, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00146A.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x001499.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x001524.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001748.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00198C.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001A49.en: 「The G Bankaran...@ It's the support mecha for the Compatible Kaiser.」

0x001AA5.en: 「A support mecha?@ It sure doesn't look like one.」

0x001AF2.en: 「That function was tacked on later, apparently.」

0x001B2F.en: 「Man, that thing's over the top in every way.@ What era of manga is that design from?@ Just what kind of guy pilots that?」

0x001BDD.en: 「What's your problem, huh? You got a complaint@ about my G Bankaran, punk?」

0x001C45.en: (Ugh, the pilot's exactly what I pictured too.)

0x001CB3.en: 「No, I didn't mean anything by it...」

0x001CF6.en: 「Hold it. A newbie picking a fight@ with my little brother? That takes some nerve.」

0x001D6E.en: 「Hmph, I'm not gonna fight a woman.@ Back off.」

0x001DC1.en: 「Ohh? You saying you're scared of me?」

0x001E7F.en: 「That's right, this isn't a fight... it's a lesson!」

0x001EF6.en: 「If you're not all talk,@ then bring it on!!」

0x001F55.en: 「Why you little! You asked for it,@ I'll make you cry!!」

0x002036.en: 「...About the BF Base, I told Kenneth directly@ that Intelligence would be handling it.@ That should keep him from making a move.」

0x0020E7.en: 「...Did you play some kind of card?」

0x002121.en: 「No. I told you before, Gilliam...@　You don't expose a scandal.@　You just make them think you're holding it over them.」

0x0021D8.en: 「A coward with something to hide will spook himself into paranoia@　over just that much. Also, I sounded Kenneth out@　about the Jinrai matter...」

0x002286.en: 「His face changed in an instant.@ From the looks of it, he knows something.」

0x0022F5.en: 「...As easy to read as ever, sir.」

0x002332.en: 「I made contact with one of Jinrai's developers...@ Minaki Tomine. Dr. Kaoru Tomine's@ adopted daughter.」

0x0023DE.en: 「Her father told her no details...@ and she seems unaware of his current whereabouts.」

0x002461.en: 「Hm, suspicious.@ So, where is Minaki Tomine now?」

0x0024AE.en: 「On my authority, she's accompanying us@ as a material witness. I've also sent my men@ to her lab to investigate.」

0x00255F.en: 「She was in contact with her father, wasn't she?@　Can you trace it to find his location?」

0x0025CA.en: 「Still investigating, but...@ most likely it's Grand Christmas.」

0x002638.en: 「I see.@ Then report to me if you turn up@ any other intel on the Gaia Sabers.」

0x0026C0.en: 「...Lieutenant General Jacob,@ within the Joint Chiefs, is the suspicion and distrust@ toward the Gaia Sabers growing stronger?」

0x002768.en: 「The Marshal intends to use them for all they're worth.@ Personally, I'm certain they're dirty.」

0x0027E2.en: 「Besides, Colonel Lefina...@ I can't imagine a woman as beautiful and clever as you@ plotting a rebellion.」

0x002888.en: 「The matter with the President was a tragedy, but...@ your decision to refuse the Gaia Sabers' takeover@ was not mistaken.」

0x00292D.en: 「That said, until the suspicions are cleared,@ you'll be treated as insurgents...」

0x002995.en: 「First, make it to Iti Iti Island@ and lie low there.」

0x0029FD.en: 「Understood.@ If you'll stand behind us as our backer,@ that's very encouraging.」

0x002A72.en: 「But the Joint Chiefs is a den of demons. If the Marshal@ decides you've no further use, he'll use you as@ a bargaining chip against Alteur.」

0x002B35.en: 「Of course, I intend to do my utmost to prevent that...@ but don't forget how precarious the situation is.」

0x002BE0.en: 「When all this is over, I'll take you to dinner.@ There's a fine place in Paris. What do you say?」

0x002C92.en: 「...You just gave the General an answer, ma'am.」

0x002CEB.en: 「Nothing, well... if it's the Captain, I'm sure it'll be fine.」

0x002D38.en: 「Then, let's set course for Iti Iti Island.」

0x002D7B.en: 「Yes.@ Signal the Hagane. We're moving out.」

0x002DF5.en: 「Captain, a course correction order came in from the Hiryu Kai.」

0x002E98.en: 「No choice.@ Running into a sub out here would be trouble.」

0x002EF1.en: 「Well, it's not like we can@ escape to the surface...」

0x002F51.en: 「Anomaly around the ship! The cause is...」

0x002FE7.en: 「Captain! The hull's enveloped in what looks like@ an abnormal gravity field, pulling us straight down!」

0x003068.en: 「Th-the gravity field, it's gone!@ But the hull's still falling!」

0x0030C1.en: 「Fire all bottom thrusters!@ At this rate we'll hit the seafloor!」

0x003126.en: 「Water pressure readings are off...!@ No, these numbers aren't water pressure at all!」

0x003210.en: 「Could it be we've come@ to La Gias again...?」

0x003263.en: 「No, this is different from that time...」

0x003297.en: 「Investigate the situation at once.@ And all hands, condition one battle stations.@ Full perimeter watch.」

0x00331C.en: 「...Captain. The gravity, pressure, temperature@ and air composition outside are the same as on land.」

0x0033A3.en: 「No, data link is impossible.@ What's more, radio and EPW both bounce back at points@ roughly three kilometers out, centered on the ship.」

0x003482.en: 「The sky and ground aside,@ if this is happening along the horizontal plane too...」

0x0034E4.en: 「Then we've been sealed inside@ some kind of enclosed space...」

0x003543.en: 「Neither the Guests nor the Gaia Sabers@ could pull off a trick like this.」

0x0035AF.en: 「The <Einst> caused a similar phenomenon@ in the past, but...」

0x003613.en: 「XO, have the pilots board their units and stand by.」

0x00364A.en: 「...Hey, Bullet.@　Doesn't this place feel familiar to you?」

0x0036BF.en: 「I can't say why, but... it reminds me of@　the Chiyou Mound, where the RyuKoOh appeared...」

0x003777.en: 「A ruin in China's Shandong region.@　The RyuKoOh lay sleeping beneath it.」

0x0037DC.en: 「So you think we were warped to China?」

0x003810.en: 「I don't know... But Dr. Anzai says Chiyou was slain@ by the Yellow Emperor, his body torn apart@ and buried in two mounds.」

0x0038DF.en: 「The head and torso in one, the limbs in the other...」

0x003922.en: 「So there may be other Chiyou Mounds@　besides the one we saw before.」

0x003999.en: 「Whether this is one of them, I can't say...」

0x0039DF.en: 「All of you, board your machines and stand by.」

0x003AE4.en: 「I-I don't know...@　but I've got a really bad feeling about this...」

0x003B59.en: 「We're going out there to chase that feeling away.@　So wait for us here, okay, Irui?」

0x003CED.en: 「Tch, a fish-thing. That one's no good.@　Michiru, it's all yours.」

0x003E57.en: 「Well, picking a fight with Lt. Katina@　was the end of her.」

0x003EAD.en: 「Y-yeah... a few seconds of trading punches...@　then that counter...」

0x003F0C.en: 「I gotta say, boss lady, your brawlin' style floored me.」

0x003F4F.en: 「Nah, you've got decent form yourself.@　Keep at it.」

0x004033.en: 「The KoOhKi...@　has it really become our enemy?」

0x004080.en: 「But that color isn't the KoOhKi's true one.@　Kukuru called it corruption, but I don't see it that way.@　That color's been twisted.」

0x004131.en: 「There are more machines that look like <Chokijin>...」

0x004196.en: 「Could that be the Genbu Dr. Anzai mentioned...@　Is that a Chokijin of the Four Gods too?」

0x004204.en: 「What...?!@　Then that means those too could be...」

0x004264.en: 「After ages beyond count, the Chokijin of the Four Gods@　meet at last. And the girl who pilots the Seiryu...@　I've longed to face you.」

0x004366.en: 「You said that once before too, didn't you.」

0x0043B9.en: 「Can you hear me, everyone?@　Lend me your attention for a moment.」

0x00446E.en: 「Close, but not quite. I am Kanan Jun, a Nansen@　who gathers beneath the god Baral.@　Call me Kanan.」

0x0045A5.en: 「So-called sennin... those who have ascended to immortality.」

0x0045DF.en: 「Sennin, like... the ones who ride on clouds@　and live on mist and peaches?」

0x004666.en: 「Sort of. Immortal, undying,@ blissfully naive eco-friendly types, right?」

0x0046C5.en: 「Fuo-ho-ho, such a view is well and good, well and good.」

0x004702.en: 「Ain't nothin' happy about it.@　You're the ones who've been throwing@　youkijin at us all this time, aren't ya!」

0x004783.en: 「And warping us into this space@　was your doing as well?」

0x0047DC.en: 「Yes... I wanted to test your strength.@　So I made a few arrangements.」

0x00483B.en: 「So what do you want with us?」

0x004869.en: 「Let me be blunt.@　We've judged that you possess the qualities@　worthy of this world's guardians.」

0x0048FC.en: 「So we've prepared this place, hoping@　to welcome you into Baral.」

0x00497A.en: 「You came to recruit Shouko and the others?!」

0x0049B4.en: 「Yes. Baral, the god we serve, has since ancient times@ led the Chokijin against the hundred evils@ and guarded this Earth, this human world.」

0x004A59.en: 「In other words, our aims and yours are the same...@　There's no reason to be enemies.」

0x004AB2.en: 「Those words are hard to swallow right off the bat.」

0x004AE9.en: 「The youkijin you sent burned a whole city down!@　How do you explain that?!」

0x004B69.en: 「In times like these, the youkijin's existence and power@　are what's needed. In the end, that will save people.」

0x004C0E.en: 「True, lost life is a sad thing - and not just@ human life. The beasts, birds, fish, grass and@ trees of this land are all precious.」

0x004CCB.en: 「But they too are vital parts of the wheel of@　life and rebirth. Their lives are not spent in vain...」

0x004D54.en: 「I promise you, we will treat their lives with care@　and give them the most radiant meaning of all.」

0x004DBC.en: 「Use their lives...?!@　Just who do you think you are?!」

0x004E0C.en: 「You talk as though you stood in the place of a god.」

0x004E55.en: 「We too are but a part of the vast universe.@ Though we're of a different order of being than you humans.」

0x004ECF.en: 「If you claim to be protectors of the human world,@　then why did the RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh choose@　to fight alongside us?」

0x004F71.en: 「Unlike the JakuOhKi and BuOhKi here, the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi@　have always been a stubborn pair.」

0x004FEB.en: 「Then the Chokijin of Suzaku and Genbu are...?!」

0x005028.en: 「They follow us of their own will.@　That is the proper form for Chokijin,@　made to guard the human world.」

0x0050C7.en: 「Then you're not controlling the Chokijin@　by some psychic power...?!」

0x005120.en: 「We are sennin, after all.@　We control them by means unlike a human's.」

0x00517F.en: 「If you call yourselves Earth's guardians,@　why did you never appear in the wars until now?」

0x0051FC.en: 「That's right. Aliens, Einst, all sorts@　of things came to attack the Earth...@　and where were you through all of it?」

0x0052AD.en: 「Ah... therein lies the very reason@　we would welcome you in.」

0x005300.en: 「Worn down by the wars against the hundred evils@ and the wars of old, Baral and we both@ had to fall into a long slumber.」

0x0053A2.en: 「The recent calamity brought by the hundred evils@　roused Taihoku and me... but the god Baral@　has yet to awaken.」

0x005447.en: 「With 'her' power, we could have driven the invaders@　back... but in the end, we've been forced to@　leave this world's protection to you.」

0x005507.en: (Her, is it. So this god Baral is a goddess.)

0x00554D.en: 「For that, we truly are sorry.@　Even now, our forces are far from complete...@　We have no choice but to employ even the youkijin.」

0x005610.en: 「So you mean to make up your lacking strength with us?」

0x00565C.en: 「Yes.@　The god Baral will soon awaken... but then@　came the great evil you call the Ruina.」

0x0056E0.en: 「They can seal off land, which troubles even us...@ While we wondered what to do,@ you drove them back for us.」

0x005797.en: 「It seems there's one among you who holds@　the key to undoing the Ruina's barrier.」

0x005852.en: 「Do you intend to fight the Ruina as well?」

0x005889.en: 「We do.@　Their master is the Rago-shin, come from beyond the killing star...@　an ill god who eclipses the sun and brings ruin.」

0x005921.en: 「No, not only the Ruina. Seeking the road@　to the Great Heaven, the myriad demons and@　hundred evils will appear in this world.」

0x0059AB.en: 「The Earth you dwell on is in more peril@　than you realize. That is why we would guard this world@　and guide humankind toward a better path.」

0x005A81.en: 「There it is. The same tired line@　that folks like you always trot out.」

0x005AD7.en: 「So you mean to rule over humanity...@　no, over this whole Earth?」

0x005B30.en: 「This isn't rule. Best to return this world@ to its natural state... upon that, we wish to build@ a 'paradise within the mortal world.'」

0x005C1E.en: 「The mortal world is this world we live in.@　Paradise, an ideal land... something like a utopia.」

0x005CA4.en: 「By nature, paradise is not a thing to be sought.@　It shows itself to none who go searching for it.」

0x005D24.en: 「But in this age of war and strife,@　we can't afford such luxuries. Under a god's protection,@　we need a sanctuary safe from every calamity.」

0x005DD5.en: 「So you mean to guide humanity into@　something like a shelter.」

0x005E31.en: 「Bet it ain't a free ride, either.」

0x005E77.en: 「Indeed. Inviting mortals into this paradise only@　to have them wage war and destruction would defeat the point.」

0x005EE5.en: 「I'm starting to see. Only those chosen by you@　get to go, is that it?」

0x005F60.en: 「We don't do the choosing.@　If you possess the proper qualities and can raise your rank,@　the road to paradise will open on its own.」

0x006036.en: 「Don't tell me you mean shikai is required?」

0x0060BA.en: 「Put simply, casting off the flesh to become a sennin.」

0x006100.en: 「Ack?!@　If our bodies are gone, aren't we just like ghosts...?」

0x00615C.en: 「No need to worry.@　The shikai we perform has a far higher rate of@　success than the usual kind.」

0x0061D1.en: 「Sound of body and mind as you are, with strong@　soul-force, you'll almost surely be fine.」

0x00623C.en: 「...And those who aren't, what becomes of them?」

0x00627C.en: 「Their three souls go where they ought to go.」

0x0062CC.en: 「So whether they want it or not,@　everyone who fails shikai just dies?!」

0x006393.en: 「Even if the shikai succeeds, you'd no longer be human, no?@　And your form wouldn't stay as it was, surely?」

0x00641F.en: 「No cause for worry there.@　In shikai the body of flesh is lost, but@　the immortal body takes shape according to the soul.」

0x0064A9.en: 「You can transcend even gender, or if you wish,@　remain in the same form as before shikai.@　...As I have.」

0x006542.en: 「So you can change your shape as you please.」

0x006582.en: 「Yes. And if a part has been lost,@　it can be restored to what it was.」

0x0065F4.en: 「Those with no soul, or whose souls have been@ tampered with, cannot undergo shikai.@ I won't name names, but some of you know who you are.」

0x0066C6.en: 「Either way, this shikai and paradise they speak of@　is a dangerous doctrine of the chosen few.」

0x006728.en: 「No, we wish all humans could undergo shikai.@　That is the very aim of the 'Total Human Shikai Plan.'」

0x0067C1.en: 「If it succeeds, your mortal-world troubles are solved.@ Those who undergo shikai live in peace and health,@ without eating away at this world.」

0x006875.en: 「Now that's a nasty sales pitch.@　Quit being human and be happy, huh?」

0x0068DA.en: 「Don't mistake us.@　We're not out to destroy humanity like the Ruina.」

0x006957.en: 「We mean to raise your rank and grant you the means@　to escape the calamities to come.」

0x0069C2.en: 「If that many people die for it,@　then your shikai itself is a calamity!」

0x006A30.en: 「Well, just how many humans will succeed at shikai@　is anyone's guess until we try.」

0x006ABD.en: 「Oh my, so you're vague on that part.」

0x006AEE.en: 「And you'd drag so many people into@　such a half-baked plan...!」

0x006B59.en: 「By rights, we'd shikai only willing, qualified people...@ but we must plan for the worst,@ in case the fight with the Ruina ends in ruin.」

0x006C4A.en: 「The battle between the god Baral and the 'King of Ruin'@　will be fierce beyond measure.@　There's no guarantee humanity survives it.」

0x006CEC.en: 「So the moment we're ready, we perform humanity's shikai.@　We want you to be the vanguard,@　to set the example for the rest.」

0x006D91.en: 「Third rank, fifth rank, I don't know and I don't care.@　Count me out!」

0x006DE7.en: 「A quick answer indeed.@　You've no use for greater power and long life?@　It'd make your own goals easier to reach.」

0x006EA8.en: 「If you wanna fight the Ruina, just be straight@　with us and cooperate, already!」

0x006F10.en: 「...And how about you over there?@　For you, wouldn't shikai be a help?」

0x006FB5.en: (So sniffing out things like that@　is a sennin's ability too?)

0x00700B.en: 「Your troubles would be solved at once.@　Provided the shikai succeeds, of course.」

0x007073.en: 「Sorry, but I've no intention of giving up my humanity.」

0x0070AD.en: 「I see.@　Then if anyone wishes to undergo shikai,@　step forward and say so.」

0x007116.en: 「Hm, no one at all? That too is well and good.」

0x00714A.en: 「Maybe that's why the shrine maiden set her sights on them too.」

0x007190.en: (Were they the ones calling to me...?)

0x0071D0.en: 「Your plan will bring calamity upon countless people.@　I have no intention of accepting it.」

0x007253.en: 「It's the surest, most efficient way, though.@ Still, I never thought words alone would settle it -@ I admire the spine to refuse us outright.」

0x00731F.en: 「But@　the young siblings who don't yet grasp the way of things need guidance.@　With power, I'll show you the path you're meant to walk.」

0x0073AC.en: 「Here they come...!　All units, prepare to intercept!」

0x0073E0.en: 「Now then, girl of the Azure Dragon...@　won't you tell me your name?」

0x00746D.en: 「Kusuha... a cool, lovely name.@　It suits you. I like you more and more.@　The Azure Dragon and you both - I'll make you mine.」

0x007522.en: 「I like women like her...@　girls with a serene spirit and a full,@　shapely body.」

0x0075A6.en: 「And that's your excuse, at a time like this!?」

0x0075EF.en: 「Ah, slender girls aren't my type. Sorry.」

0x007651.en: 「What a pushy way to court a girl.@　I'd have Bullet take lessons from you.」

0x007725.en: 「For the record, I'm no man.@　If you must sort by common gender, I'm a woman.」

0x0077DA.en: 「Well then... shall we begin?@　KoOhKi, you too - go reclaim your other half.」

0x00786E.en: 「Bullet,@　I think those people are controlling the KoOhKi...!」

0x0078C7.en: 「Yeah.@　If we drive them off, maybe it'll@　come back to us.」

0x007936.en: 「I wonder about that.@　You know the power of the Four Gods' Chokijin well.@　This JakuOhKi is even fiercer than the KoOhKi.」

0x0079D5.en: 「...All units, don't lay a hand on the KoOhKi.@　If it attacks, deflect it. Main targets are@　the JakuOhKi and the BuOhKi!」

0x007A71.en: 「Come to me, Kusuha. I won't hurt you.」

0x007AB1.en: 「No. The way you people do things,@　too many people will suffer.」

0x007B8A.en: 「Even so,@　I won't cast that aside from the very start!」

0x007BEF.en: 「Heheh, saying that without flinching...@　I like you more and more, Kusuha.」

0x007C51.en: 「Pilot of the White Tiger... what are you to Kusuha?」

0x007C8E.en: 「Like I have any reason to tell YOU that!」

0x007CCE.en: 「Fine, then.@　The KoOhKi seems to have taken a liking to you,@　so I'll invite you along too. Only...」

0x007D7D.en: 「Shut up!@　I won't let you have Kusuha or the KoOhKi!」

0x007DD0.en: 「So you choose the hard road. That too is well.」

0x007E0A.en: 「It's not hard, it's the obvious choice!@　I don't need your guidance...@　I have no intention of becoming an immortal!」

0x007E9D.en: 「Indeed.@　Obey us or resist us...@　do as your heart wills.」

0x007F19.en: 「The KoOhKi isn't obeying of its own will...@　You're the ones controlling it, aren't you!?」

0x007FBE.en: 「The KoOhKi's color right now!@　A black White Tiger is a contradiction! That's not its true form!」

0x008073.en: 「I can't have you interfering now!@　Sorry, but I'll stop you in your tracks!」

0x0080D5.en: 「...Now then, let's have the JakuOhKi and BuOhKi@　show what they're really made of.」

0x00813B.en: 「Really made of!?　So those two, just as I thought!!」

0x00817E.en: 「Just as you thought - what's that supposed to mean!?」

0x0081B8.en: 「They combine, just like@　the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi do!!」

0x00829A.en: 「I can feel it... the RyuJinKi's hostility and rage...!」

0x0082D7.en: 「It's the same for the JakuBuOh.@　She won't forgive the RyuKoOh for abandoning its rightful master and duty.」

0x008348.en: 「In the last clash the RyuKoOh won...@　but back then the JakuBuOh wasn't whole -@　it was still wounded from earlier battles.」

0x008418.en: 「Just as the RyuKoOh absorbed your machine dolls and returned somewhat altered...@ we too reshaped the JakuBuOh, reviving it near its true form.」

0x0084E7.en: 「And into this Gensenkyou we've@　shifted the Chiyuu Mound - the JakuBuOh's@　homeland, so to speak - by a hair's-breadth boundary transfer.」

0x008565.en: 「What's more, I'm the one piloting the JakuBuOh - the South Immortal of Baral.@　With only a half-Chokijin between you, you don't stand a chance.」

0x0085EE.en: 「With your power, there's no escaping this Gensenkyou.@　Now then, how long will that spirit of yours hold?」

0x008677.en: 「We're not soft enough@　to throw in the towel over this much!」

0x0086EC.en: 「Well, if you die here I'll grant you shikai.@　So come at me without holding back.」

0x008766.en: 「If we're shot down here,@　will we become their captives like the KoOhKi?」

0x0087CE.en: 「Put another way, unless we die, shikai is impossible...@　It seems they can't perform shikai@　freely at this stage.」

0x008876.en: 「Right.@　And they also said carrying out the@　Total Human Shikai Plan requires preparation.」

0x0088E5.en: 「If they could force shikai on us at will,@　we'd already be dancing to their tune.」

0x00895F.en: 「Which means we have the means and the time to stop their plan...」

0x0089AB.en: 「For a good shikai, the subject must truly crave it.@ I could force it on you now, but the result would be flawed.」

0x008A80.en: 「...So you set this stage@　to make us submit from the heart.」

0x008AF5.en: 「Absurd!　Our hearts won't break to a trick like this!@　Vile immortals, you'll learn that firsthand!」

0x008C27.en: 「To break their spears, a shield is best, no?@　There's something else I'd like to test, too.」

0x008C8F.en: 「Quite so. Then - reversal of the divine order.」

0x008D44.en: 「Now then, let me mend the talisman.@ Shinnou Entei, guard me - this blade fells all demons and ills, swift as the law commands!」

0x008DE0.en: 「I-it fixed the damage in an instant...!」

0x008E0E.en: 「What the heck is that!　That's cheating!」

0x008E42.en: 「The Black Tortoise's defense stands out even among Chokijin.@ Add my arts, and you get this.@ Come, throw everything you have at me.」

0x008F05.en: 「That healing... a war of attrition puts us at a disadvantage.」

0x008F9E.en: 「Shinnou Entei, guard my body, one stroke of this blade,@　what demon flees not, what illness heals not, swift as the law commands.」

0x009003.en: 「Captain,@　the battle with the BuJakuOh is falling into a stalemate.」

0x00905C.en: 「If we can break out of this space,@　we might find a way through...」

0x0090BE.en: 「Shall we attempt long-range fire on the boundary?」

0x00916D.en: （At this rate... everyone... there's no escape...）

0x0091D5.en: 「At this rate, we'll get nowhere!@　Isn't there something we can do...!?」

0x00922B.en: 「If it's true the RyuKoOh beat the JakuBuOh,@　then the BuJakuOh can't be invincible@　either, I'd think...」

0x0092C1.en: 「You mean the RyuKoOh could beat that thing...!?」

0x009326.en: 「To get it back, we'd have to break Kanan's@　control. Are we just going in circles...!?」

0x00940E.en: 「But it seems they haven't yet@　reached the breaking point.」

0x009467.en: 「We can't afford to take too long.@　Let's land a heavy blow here.」

0x00962F.en: 「Fuo-ho-ho, so the divine servant has appeared!」

0x009811.en: 「Abnormal gravity field forming around the ship!@　It's expanding!!」

0x009940.en: 「My heart won't break - I won't let it break... that's what I swore!」

0x00998C.en: 「Heheh, that's exactly the kind of heart worth breaking.」

0x009C6A.en: 「Captain, our current position nearly matches@　where we were before being dragged into the Gensenkyou.」

0x009D06.en: 「Nowhere in sight.@　It seems that shark saved us.」

0x00B4BF.en: 「That's what I thought too, but@　after hearing what the Princess said, it got to me...」

0x00B533.en: 「Ibis... if something like this happens again@　and Irui seems anxious, we should maybe@　talk to Radha about it...」

0x00B650.en: 「Indeed.@　It drove us back and saved the ship carrying the shrine maiden.」

0x00B6A3.en: 「But when Kukuru and the KoOhKi struck@　at the far north, no Shinboku appeared...」

0x00B71D.en: 「That'd be Kukuru's doing, wouldn't it?@　There was no need for them to show up.」

0x00B7BC.en: 「That's about the size of it.@　A difference in class, you might say.」

0x00B80A.en: 「...Ah, Kanan.@　I hear your recruitment attempt failed?」

0x00B873.en: 「And you angered a Shinboku, from what I hear.」

0x00B8B0.en: 「That's not settled yet.@　Besides, I got something out of it.」

0x00B928.en: 「I learned the Seiryuu girl's name.@　Kusuha Mizuha... a cool, pleasant ring to it, no?」

0x00B9D0.en: 「Hmph... she'll be mine.@　Kouryuu, I won't hand her to you.」

0x00BA4B.en: 「Yes, this time I'll change tactics.@ A second Shinboku means the maiden's surely@ chosen Kusuha's group, just as we predicted.」

0x00BAFC.en: 「True, she does seem to be nearing her awakening...@　but I'd like to let the espers ripen a while longer.」

0x00BB91.en: 「You're telling me to keep out of it?」

0x00BBAD.en: 「They grow on their own, so@　isn't that the easier path? Who knows,@　maybe they'll even destroy Ruina for us.」

0x00BC5B.en: 「Holding the key is one thing.@　Whether they can wield it freely is another.」

0x00BCBD.en: 「Which is exactly why they need time to ripen.@　Rushing now would be a mistake. Overwater a plant@　and the roots rot, don't they?」

0x00BD68.en: 「Before that, I'll pluck the flower and set it in a vase.@　Yes... the flower called Kusuha Mizuha.」
